# McGregor Boyall

> > McGregor Boyall is a global recruitment consultancy delivering specialized staffing, executive search, and talent acquisition solutions across financial services, professional services, and public sectors since 1987.

With 30+ years of expertise, McGregor Boyall provides comprehensive recruitment services including permanent placement, contract staffing, executive search, and embedded recruitment solutions. The firm operates across multiple regions including the UK, North America, Europe, Middle East, and Dubai, serving diverse sectors with a commitment to inclusive hiring practices.

## Core Services

- [Permanent Recruitment Solutions](https://www.mcgregor-boyall.com/our-services/permanent-recruitment-solutions): Permanent recruitment expertise across financial, professional, and life sciences sectors
- [Executive Search Recruitment](https://www.mcgregor-boyall.com/our-services/executive-search-recruitment): Executive search for leadership across professional services sectors
- [Contract Recruitment](https://www.mcgregor-boyall.com/our-services/contract-recruitment): Contract recruitment with IR35 compliance and fast placement
- [Retained Search Recruitment](https://www.mcgregor-boyall.com/our-services/retained-search-recruitment): Retained search for executive and senior leadership positions
- [Contingent Recruitment Services](https://www.mcgregor-boyall.com/our-services/contingent-recruitment): Contingent recruitment solutions with pay-on-success model
- [Embedded Recruitment Services](https://www.mcgregor-boyall.com/our-services/embedded-recruitment-services): Embedded recruitment outsourcing across multiple sectors
- [Talent Acquisition Consulting](https://www.mcgregor-boyall.com/our-services/talent-acquisition-consulting): Talent acquisition consulting and workforce planning strategy
- [All Services Overview](https://www.mcgregor-boyall.com/our-services): Overview of recruitment services including staffing and DEI solutions
